about: What a failed turn says in both CLIs, the chat and -p alike (2026-09-25): a headline in plain words and one line of what to do, never the platform's protocol text. `message` is what the SDK raised or streamed (each SDK words the same refusal differently: the TypeScript proxy skill keeps the socket's close code, the Python one rewrites a refused sign-in and its error keeps the cause). `code` is the stable code `-p --output-format stream-json` reports for Robutler's own refusals (null: the SDK's own code, if any, is passed through). `proxy` is true when the turn ran on Robutler's models; `proxy_url` is then the socket the chat used. Python: tests/cli/test_failure_presentation.py, TypeScript: tests/unit/cli/failures.test.ts.

cases.name: a platform that does not run models for a CLI sign-in (TypeScript's words)
cases.message: session.create requires X-Payment-Token in session.extensions [WebSocket closed unexpectedly (code=4001)]
cases.headline: Robutler at wss://robutler.test/llm does not run models for a CLI sign-in.
cases.hint: Use a provider key: webagents secrets set OPENAI_API_KEY.

cases.name: the same refusal, in Python's words
cases.message: Robutler at wss://robutler.test/llm does not run models for a CLI sign-in. Use a provider key: webagents secrets set OPENAI_API_KEY. (session.create requires X-Payment-Token in session.extensions)
cases.headline: Robutler at wss://robutler.test/llm does not run models for a CLI sign-in.
cases.hint: Use a provider key: webagents secrets set OPENAI_API_KEY.

cases.name: not enough credits
cases.message: Not enough credits to start a model call. Add credits in Robutler, or use your own provider key. [WebSocket closed unexpectedly (code=4002)]
cases.headline: Not enough credits to start a model call.
cases.hint: Add credits in Robutler, or use a provider key of your own (webagents secrets set OPENAI_API_KEY).

cases.name: a sign-in the platform did not accept
cases.message: session.create requires X-Payment-Token, or the Bearer token `webagents login` stores as Authorization, in session.extensions [WebSocket closed unexpectedly (code=4001)]
cases.headline: Robutler did not accept your sign-in.
cases.hint: Your Robutler sign-in may have expired. Type /login to sign in again.

cases.name: an expired payment token
cases.headline: Robutler did not accept your sign-in.
cases.hint: Your Robutler sign-in may have expired. Type /login to sign in again.

cases.name: the platform cannot be reached
cases.headline: Could not reach Robutler at wss://robutler.test/llm.

cases.name: anything else on the platform keeps its own words, less the socket's close code
cases.message: The model is overloaded. [WebSocket closed unexpectedly (code=1011)]
cases.headline: The model is overloaded.
